_readme: Example of what `go-z-ai coding load claude-code` writes to ~/.claude/settings.json for the Global plan (it also sets hasCompletedOnboarding:true in ~/.claude.json). The program never reads this file; internal/coding/tools_test.go keeps it in sync with the code. The base env vars match @z_ai/coding-helper; the model tiers come from the catalog ("[1m]" is Claude Code's 1M-context suffix) and the auto-compact window from the main model's context. Override with --haiku/--sonnet/--opus/--auto-compact-window, or --no-model-mapping for the bare helper format.
